range_reason.soft: half stiffness allows fingers to yield around object contacts instead of forcing the exact kinematic pose; damping is reduced moderately rather than proportionally to avoid oscillation
range_reason.stiff: double stiffness tests whether failures are mainly tracking lag during closing/lifting; doubled damping limits overshoot
range_reason.wrist: virtual wrist gains remain fixed because changing global hand tracking would confound grasp-shape and lift-path effects

selection_rule: one global gain pair per hand; no per-trajectory gain oracle; require positive paired net gain before confirmation
